subject: CloudBridge co-host demo — runbook, test accounts, and micro-shift
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Ashley Chen <ashley@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CloudBridge / Redwood — co-hosted marketplace demo (runbook + rehearsal)

Hi Ashley,

Thanks again for committing to a co-hosted demo for the CloudBridge marketplace listing. We want to run a short internal rehearsal and align runbook ownership before the customer-facing slot next week. Can you and Ravi join a 45-minute dry run where we walk through:
- demo intro and handoff phrasing
- live API keys and test dataset access
- fallback plan (model variants + regional failover)

Our availability (PST):
- Wed Nov 24, 10:00–10:45 or 15:00–15:45
- Thu Nov 25, 09:00–09:45 or 13:00–13:45

If none of those work, propose two windows and we’ll do our best to accommodate. I’ve attached a short draft runbook and a tentative rehearsal agenda.

Attachments: runbook_draft_v1.pdf (PDF), rehearsal_agenda.xlsx (Spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

Hi Marcus — thanks for the note and the attachments. Ravi and I can make the Thu Nov 25 09:00–09:45 PST slot. Ravi (cc) will lead the technical walkthrough on our side. A couple quick asks up front:
- Do you have a short test tenant we can use so we don’t hit live data?
- Can you confirm who will open/close the meeting and who is doing the customer intro?

We’ll review the runbook and give feedback during the rehearsal. If you prefer a different cadence (30 vs 45 minutes) tell us — we can compress to 30 if it helps.

Best,
